description: Consolidate fragmented error handling hierarchy across 15+ microservices. Create a shared `@rawdrive/shared-exceptions` package with base error classes (`ServiceError`, `ValidationError`, `NotFoundError`, `AuthenticationError`, `AuthorizationError`). Currently each service reimplements custom exceptions (359+ total) with inconsistent naming and inheritance patterns, making error handling unpredictable and difficult to test. Services should inherit from shared base classes while adding service-specific errors only when necessary.
